sect1.title: Steam Dependencies
sect1.para: To ensure Steam will run properly, you must also follow the lib32 instructions of each dependency listed unless the section doesn't have those instructions or it is stated to not be needed. Moreover, the listed dependencies are all for runtime. All the tools for actual installation were built in LFS/MLFS.
